conversationalSummary.text: For TODAY, I’d give Almagreira a check first for an after-work run starting around 16:30, but it sounds a bit of a rare window. Surfline looks poor and the wind is mixed/cross-off, so it could be punchy enough at low dropping tide, or it could turn messy fast. Before I leave, I’d look at the Surfline and MEO Beachcam—if it doesn’t look noticeably cleaner than expected, I’d skip it.
